Your accent profile points to **Vietnamese** at 20 percent confidence (low certainty), with Slovene the next closest at 11 percent.

The weakest area was velar nasal (ng) at 59.7 out of 100. Let the back of the tongue meet the soft palate and release the sound through the nose without adding a hard g at the end.

Words worth repeating: accent (64.7).

Fluency came out at **86.0 out of 100** (pace 58.7, pausing 100.0, expressiveness 100.0).

You are speaking at about 1.88 syllables per second, which is on the deliberate side. A little more momentum will sound more natural.

Overall this is **78.4 out of 100**, which I would call strong.

Words worth repeating: Hello (58.7).

Fluency came out at **94.3 out of 100** (pace 100.0, pausing 79.6, expressiveness 100.0).

I heard: "Hello, my name is Rassan. I have with you."

The weakest area was labiodental /v/-/w/ at 45.1 out of 100. For v the upper teeth rest on the lower lip; for w the lips round with no teeth contact at all.

Words worth repeating: Rassan (66.0).

Fluency came out at **75.2 out of 100** (pace 99.8, pausing 11.8, expressiveness 100.0).

You are moving quickly at about 5.61 syllables per second. Easing off slightly will give your consonants room to land.

Silence took up 52 percent of the recording, with the longest gap at 0.81 seconds. Try planning a whole phrase before you begin it.

Overall this is **63.6 out of 100**, which I would call solid.
